name: Action Model · Connector Research
summary: A verified research dossier on OSS connector catalogues for the Action Model app builder: which catalogues can legally power a hosted connect-your-account section, a live spike of the leading gateway, the multi-tenancy boundary, and the resulting build order.

relationships.context: Curated under the Research section as a client-project research dossier with public metadata and a private source repository.

evidence.summary: Registered alongside the linking Event; the Research section record defines the browse surface this Work appears under.

Licence bodies were read for every headline catalogue: Elastic v2 (Nango, Airbyte), Source Available (Pipedream), Sustainable Use (n8n), AGPL (Panora), a multi-tenant prohibition (Dify), and an unlicensed plugin corpus (dify-plugins) are hosting-blocked; Apache-2.0 (open-connector), MIT outside ee/ (activepieces), CC0 (jentic-public-apis, 4,140 OpenAPI vendor directories) are adoptable.

oomol-lab/open-connector was run live: 1,445 providers and 15,156 actions generated from source, credentials verified against the live vendor and stored AES-GCM encrypted, one authenticated round-trip executed, and the absence of multi-tenancy demonstrated with two connections visible under one admin token.
The Connector room in the client-side Actionist Research OS carries the same findings as a browsable evidence room: mechanics, licence map, spike receipts, the tenancy blocker, and the build order.
Private repository holding both dated dossiers and the README integration guide; head commit verified via the GitHub API on 2026-08-27.

license.reason: Client-adjacent research metadata; the dossiers describe third-party licences but the record itself is registry metadata, and the source repository is private pending a publication decision.
